test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following does NOT match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ved Samaj- Gharalu Naidu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Swaraj Dal** was founded by **CR Das**.
 
• **Ved Samaj** is associated with **Keshab Chandra Sen**, not **Gharalu Naidu**.
 
• **Scientific Society** was established by **Syed Ahmed Khan.**
 
• **Bhoodan movement** was initiated by **Vinoba Bhave**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **CR Das**, also known as Chittaranjan Das, was a prominent freedom fighter and political leader in India.
 
• **Keshab Chandra Sen** was a prominent leader of the Brahmo Samaj, a socio-religious reform movement in India.
 
• **Syed Ahmed Khan** was a prominent Muslim reformer and the founder of the Aligarh Muslim University.
 
• **Vinoba Bhave** was a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi and a prominent social reformer who initiated the Bhoodan (land gift) movement.
